title: [bug] lichen-node rpl_stack test: root receives None instead of relay DAO (tests.rs:1828) after announce-relay fix
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:1828 — after the announce-relay drain bug (worker6-hr8t) is fixed, three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent advances further and now fails at the DAO phase: root.receive() at line ~1826 returns None where the test expects Some(RplReceiveOutcome::Dao(DaoHandlingOutcome::Applied)) for the relay's send_dao(). The drain at line ~1825 ('let _ = root.receive(1, 0).await; // Drain the relay's multicast DIO echo the root heard before the DAO') appears to consume the wrong number of frames, so the DAO is either already consumed or not yet arrived. This is a SEPARATE pre-existing frame-sequencing bug in the DAO phase, masked until now by the announce-relay panic at line 1792. Discovered from worker6-hr8t. Needs the same drain/ordering analysis for the relay DAO path.
